descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S25 「和原型 p72 并排比：扫描界面和读照片的 prompt」 Side by side with prototype p72: scan screens and the photo-reading prompts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 The design matches the prototype attached to the ticket (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html).（TFA-92580 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • T4 The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is ported word for word. Only the request format changes, to fit Gemini's API.（TFA-94425 AC 2；TFA-94425 AC 3；TFA-94425 AC 4）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html and the app on main

When Compare the scan sheet, result list, duplicate review and Add form with the prototype. Diff the census-rounding / census-snf prompts (and the other two vision prompts) with the prototype strings

Then Screens match the prototype. The prompts are identical apart from whitespace

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：A person compares the screens side by side. The prompt diff (whitespace-normalised) must be empty. Where p72 conflicts with the UAT's duplicate prompt and flags, that is Q1/Q2, not a T1 Fail

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S25 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）（STATIC (prompt-parity diff: p72 HTML vs library .md, whitespace-normalised)）；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local (prompt diff) / both (screens) 跑；来源：code-review。
